scope: Final production pinned pairs, all geometry checked. Canonical variations are retained explicitly and require a separate audit before any no-regression conclusion. Invalid results excluded from mesh speed comparisons.

full_hull.scope: Offline CGAL exact original-coordinate orientation, global empty-sphere, face pairing and hull-support checks; cospherical alternatives allowed. Not meshing or a speed comparison.

quality.scope: Independent NumPy solves, face/edge incidence and CGAL AABB triangle distances with float64 constructions; outside mesher timing. Three quadrature points per boundary face, not a Hausdorff certificate.

distance_oracle.implementation: CGAL AABB triangle distances with float64 constructions

features.scope: Offline float64 feature graph and nearest-chain projection. Boundary-referenced role-2 sites are assigned to their nearest input chain, with exact corners as open-chain anchors. Connectivity/gaps are diagnostics, not a proof of feature conformity or runtime sample ownership. Corner coordinates are checked exactly.

feature_to_boundary.quadrature: Uniform midpoint samples weighted by input segment length; no Hausdorff bound.
